one_liner_zh: 麥當勞最新季度財報營收與每股盈餘雙雙優於市場預期，展現穩健的營運韌性。
one_liner_en: McDonald's reported quarterly EPS and revenue that both beat market expectations, demonstrating solid operational resilience.
beat_or_miss: 超預期，EPS 實際值 3.38 美元高於預期的 3.32 美元，營收年增 3.76%。
highlights_zh: 每股盈餘 (EPS) 達 3.38 美元，優於市場預期的 3.32 美元。
總營收達 71 億美元，較去年同期成長 3.76%。
本益比保持在 20.56 倍，估值水準相對合理。
highlights_en: Total revenue reached $7.10B, representing a 3.76% year-over-year increase.
Trailing P/E ratio stands at a relatively reasonable 20.56.
risks_zh: 全球消費者面臨通膨壓力，可能壓抑餐飲消費支出。
餐飲與勞動成本上升可能持續侵蝕利潤率。
risks_en: Global consumers facing inflationary pressures may reduce discretionary dining outlays.
Rising food and labor costs could continue to pressure profit margins.
ai_view_zh: 觀點：財報表現穩健展現防禦屬性，訊號中性偏多。短中期利於支撐股價表現，後續應追蹤全球同店銷售額成長率及利潤率變化。
ai_view_en: View: Solid financial results reflect strong defensive attributes, signaling a neutral-to-positive outlook. This supports near-to-mid-term stock performance. Key metrics to track include global comparable store sales growth and margin trends.
